title: More numerical cache states do not acquire new source evidence
statement: For a FIXED observable and fixed independent source sample counts m_i, product empirical integration has V_data=sum_(nonempty S) sigma_S^2/product_(i in S)m_i. K conditionally independent numerical evaluations from that empirical product law give MSE=V_data+(Var_P f-V_data)/K. Increasing K reduces numerical integration error only; dependent numerical states require their actual finite-run conditional variance, and equally informed ordinary integration receives the same empirical law/preprocessing/cached work. Selecting f from the same production data needs independent selection or justified simultaneous/selective inference. Public value-dependent maintenance is information: a zero-change count on three refreshed fair selected bits gives conditional TV7/8. Finite joint-TV error delta changes bounded-estimator MSE by<=delta but need not preserve a relative variance guarantee near zero variance.

For inference lower bounds the stated admissible product family and local perturbations/finite expected stopping assumptions apply; endpoint minimax results use the full family rather than a bounded-bias subfamily.
